The output polarity was inverted. `vinp` drove the output-side device (M2), so the loop around the follower test latched to VDD. That forced M1 and M4 into triode, which is why every metric collapsed. The fix is to put `vinp` on the diode side (M1) and `vinn` on the output side (M2). I also corrected the CMRR model to A0·2gm3/gds_t and lengthened the tail L for more margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Fix inverted polarity: vinp must drive the diode side of the NMOS-pair 5T OTA. The closed loop latched to VDD and pushed M1/M4 into triode. Also corrected the CMRR model and lengthened the tail device for CMRR margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff pair L
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.4, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "itail": (60e-6, 45e-6, 80e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidt": (12.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # tail / bias mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail = p["itail"]
    i1 = itail / 2.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.6)
    m3d = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
    mbd = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mbd = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mbd.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], itail, vds=0.4)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbd)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp on the diode side, vinn on the output side -> non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = itail / cout
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = 4 * noise_th
    swing = (1.8 - (m3.vdsat + 0.1)) - (0.9 - m1.vgs + m1.vdsat + 0.1)
    gtail = max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    cmrr_db = db(a0 * 2 * m3.gm / gtail)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau * 1.2
    power = 1.8 * (iref + itail)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "swing": swing,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
        "psrr_db": db(a0),
        "settle": settle,
        "power": power,
    }
```
